display.purpose: Page titles and login headline only.

body.purpose: Default table, form, and metadata reading.

label.purpose: Field labels, table headers, and compact status markers.

buttons: Product-page buttons must use the shared primary, secondary, and danger vocabulary instead of legacy blue, teal, black, gradient, or unscoped global button styles.
Primary actions use champagne gold fill (#a67c2f) with warm white text; hover and focus use stronger bronze (#876223).
Secondary and cancel actions use warm white or ivory surfaces, gold-tinted borders (#ded2bb), bronze or ink text, and restrained hover (#faf4e8 / #b99652).
Buttons that appear together, especially in toolbars or modal footers, must share height, radius, padding, weight, and focus behavior.
modals: Any popup, chooser, editor, confirmation, import preview, or publish dialog is a modal window by default unless a feature spec explicitly requires a popover, drawer, toast, or inline disclosure.
Modal windows use a blocking overlay, role=dialog, aria-modal=true, a labelled heading, an opaque warm ivory surface, and a fixed footer when actions are present.
Modal footers use secondary buttons for cancel or close actions and primary champagne-gold buttons for confirm or save actions.
Close controls are quiet icon buttons without bordered button blocks.

The top-right close x must render as a bare icon or glyph with no visible border, no bordered square or circle, and no button chrome; hover and focus may use a subtle tinted background but must remain borderless.
tabs: Product-page tabs use text tabs, not pills, chips, segmented controls, or bordered mini-cards.
Tab rows may use a single Gold Mist Line bottom rule (#ded2bb) when separating tabs from following content; do not wrap the tab row in a rounded container.
Inactive tabs use Warm Bronze Secondary text (#5f523f), compact bold weight, and no background fill.
Active tabs use accent-primary-strong text (#876223) with a 2px line-strong underline (#b99652) aligned to the label; no rounded active background.
Detail panes such as user information, skill fields, and settings sections should reuse this tab style unless a feature spec explicitly requires another pattern.
noNestedBackgroundFrames: Do not add background boxes inside already framed product panels.
Rows, tabs, search interiors, status labels, trace details, metric groups, and detail summaries should use text hierarchy and the minimum necessary 1px divider lines.
No box-in-box, per-row background blocks, selected-row fills, hover fills, chip backgrounds, row shadows, or inner box-shadow focus frames inside product panels.
Selected states inside panels should use strong text color, font weight, or tab underline instead of rounded background containers.
Selected, active, hover, pressed, focus, and focus-visible states inside product panels must never add box-shadow, glow, row shadow, inset shadow, raised-card treatment, or browser-like focus shadow.
Do not add a new border for selection when text hierarchy or an existing divider can carry the state.

productUiScale.purpose: Default scale rules for newly added authenticated product UI, including assistant composer tools, popovers, pickers, menus, toolbar controls, and inline settings.
rules: New product controls, chooser rows, popovers, composer tools, table actions, toolbar buttons, menu items, and inline settings must default to 13px text unless they are true section titles or page headings.
Codes, descriptions, helper text, menu metadata, and compact badges should use 11px to 12px with muted bronze or metadata color only when that secondary detail is required for the task.
Small product tools and icon buttons should use 32px to 34px height, 10px radius, 13px text, and 15px to 16px icons.
Larger 38px or taller controls are reserved for primary actions, dialog footers, or touch-heavy contexts.
Skill lists, command menus, row menus, and lightweight pickers must use compact row density instead of card-like rows, per-item background blocks, row shadows, oversized icons, or 15px+ menu labels.
Inside framed product panels, rows, tabs, search interiors, status labels, trace details, metric groups, and detail summaries must not use nested background boxes or card-like wrappers.
Selected, active, hover, pressed, focus, and focus-visible states inside product panels must never use box-shadow, glow, row shadow, inset shadow, or raised-card treatment.
Selection inside product panels should prefer text color, font weight, or tab underline; avoid adding a new border when text hierarchy or an existing divider is enough.

Small floating menus attached to composer tools, icon buttons, or row actions should use 12px primary text, optional 10px to 11px metadata only when needed, 13px to 14px icons, 26px to 30px rows, and 168px to 220px width.

Lightweight floating menus use opaque warm ivory surfaces, gold-mist borders, restrained shadows only when needed, ink primary text, and transparent rows instead of stacked-card styling or per-row background blocks.
Compact skill, command, and picker lists should display the human-facing name as the primary label and should not show implementation codes, slugs, ids, or secondary metadata by default.
Compact picker rows must not use hover backgrounds, selected backgrounds, per-row background blocks, row shadows, or card-like rounded row containers by default.

Search fields inside dense product workspaces should use either one simple outer control or a bottom rule; the native input itself must stay transparent with no inner border, no box shadow, and no blue browser focus frame.
Any newly added product UI must reuse this typography and control scale before adding page-local large fonts, fat buttons, or oversized menu rows.

adminCrudLists.purpose: Durable guardrails for authenticated admin CRUD list pages, based on the /admin/skills list hardening.

density.emptyState: compact table row or concise note, not a tall blank composition

layoutRules: Keep title, toolbar, filters, and table in content-height rows so filtering or empty results cannot stretch the page.
Full-width toolbar inputs must use box-sizing:border-box, max-width:100%, min-width:0, and focus rings that do not change layout size.
Grid and flex parents that contain lists, toolbars, tables, or cells must provide min-width:0 so long content cannot widen the page.
Normal admin CRUD lists must not create horizontal scroll. If horizontal scroll is unavoidable, document the exception in the feature spec and keep it local to that table.
tableRules: Never apply display:flex, display:grid, display:block, or display:-webkit-box directly to table, thead, tbody, tr, th, or td.
Put text clamps, wrapping, chips, and flex action groups inside inner cell elements, while real table cells remain table cells.
Dense admin tables should use table-layout:fixed with an explicit colgroup or equivalent column contract.
Long names, codes, summaries, and empty values must truncate or wrap inside the cell instead of widening the table.
toolbarRules: Buttons in the same toolbar must share height, radius, padding, font weight, border, hover, and focus vocabulary.
Secondary admin toolbar buttons use warm white surfaces, gold-tinted borders, ink or bronze text, and restrained hover.
List scope filters are text tabs, not large pill buttons.
Active filter tabs on gold-led product pages use accent-primary-strong text (#876223) and line-strong underline (#b99652), not teal or green unless the state is semantic success.
rowActionRules: Dense list rows should not permanently show multiple secondary buttons.
Use a hover/focus more trigger for secondary row actions such as edit, export, and delete.
The unified row action structure is a three-dot trigger plus an opaque vertical menu; new admin tables should prefer the shared admin-row-menu class family.
More triggers should be vertically centered in the row, borderless, and visually quiet until hover or focus.
Menus must be opaque and use consistent menu-item styling for links and buttons; destructive actions may change text color but not sizing vocabulary.
Keep the real td as a table cell and place the trigger/menu inside a child wrapper; never make td/th/tr flex, grid, block, or clamped boxes.
List pages must not expose actions outside their responsibility, such as publishing from a page where publishing belongs to the editor or governance flow.
Standard or read-only rows should not show edit/view affordances when product rules disallow inspection or modification from that surface.
copyRules: Admin list UI labels should stay Chinese-only unless the feature spec explicitly asks for bilingual labels.
Remove auxiliary eyebrow or subtitle text when it does not improve scanning or task completion.
regressionChecks: Switch each filter tab and confirm search width, table width, row height, and page spacing remain stable.
Type a query that returns no results and confirm the page does not stretch vertically or horizontally.
Hover rows and open action menus, then confirm row height, column alignment, and menu opacity remain stable.
Check desktop and compact widths for no incoherent overlap, no horizontal scrollbar, and consistent button styling.

narrative.componentPhilosophy: Compact product-surface controls for assistant, admin, and platform workflows with restrained gold linework.
dos: Use gold only for intent, focus, and structural emphasis.
Prefer border and tonal separation over decorative depth.
donts: Do not use large dark surfaces.
Do not use glassmorphism or marketing-page styling.
Do not create box-in-box product panels, nested background frames, row cards, selected-row fills, hover fills, chip backgrounds, or row shadows inside framed product surfaces.
reuseGuidance: Preserve warm ivory surfaces, ink-heavy typography, and bright champagne-gold edge contrast as a matched set.
Use the style as the default baseline for authenticated assistant, admin, and platform product surfaces, not marketing pages.
Keep gold on lines, focus, active states, and premium actions instead of flooding large fills.
